audit.whatIsWrong: Four rows contradicted the whys beneath them: Level 1 and Level 2 were Skill/Yorick while both whys said 'Warwick-favoured', Level 3 was Yorick while its why said 'Skill', and Level 6 was Skill while its why said 'Yorick-favoured'.
audit.why: Before Yorick has a ghoul pack he trades with Last Rites and autos, which Warwick's Q heal-for-damage-dealt beats; the lane turns at 6 when Eulogy of the Isles (160s at rank 1) adds the Maiden.
audit.corrected: Rows 0 and 1 to Warwick, row 2 to Skill, row 4 to Yorick — matched full/content pairs, ratings moved to 7/10, 7/10 and 3/10, and phases[4].why rewritten to name the ultimate that causes the flip.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[5].why and phases[6].why sold Warwick's Blade of the Ruined King and two-item side lane on rows the chart gives to Yorick, and phases[4].why gave no reason for the level-6 swing.
audit.why: Eulogy of the Isles is 160/130/100 — the longest cooldown in the matchup and the real level-6 spike. After it, Maiden plus a bruiser item out-damages Warwick's sustain, and a full ghoul pack out-splits him.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why now states the 160s rank-1 ultimate and the Maiden; phases[5].why re-keyed to Mourning Mist's window; phases[6].why re-keyed to the split-push threat.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeated 'don't get caged' four times without ever saying what the cage does mechanically, and Mourning Mist's armour reduction and ghoul-summoning behaviour were never stated.
audit.why: Dark Procession (W, 20/18/16/14/12s, 600 range) summons a DESTRUCTIBLE wall that blocks movement — it is terrain, so it stops Jaws of the Beast's lunge and Infinite Duress's leap in both directions, and you can attack it down instead of walking around it. Mourning Mist (E, 12/11/10/9/8s, 700 range) reduces armour, slows and marks, and his summoned units gain move speed toward marked targets, so the mark is what makes the ghoul pack dangerous, not the ghouls alone. Last Rites heals him and resets his attack, which is why Executioner's Calling is already correct in the build.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d states the 20s cooldown and that the cage is destructible; dontsFull[0].d states it is terrain that blocks your Q and R both ways; dosFull[1].d carries Mourning Mist's 12s cooldown and armour cut; dontsFull[1].d states ghouls sprinting at the mark.

edits.before: Infinite Duress is a point-and-click fight starter that locks his carry tool. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Yorick's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Eulogy of the Isles is 160s at rank 1 and adds the Maiden plus a ghoul wall — this stage is his, so take your fights before he presses it.

edits.before: Blade of the Ruined King is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Dark Procession's cooldown.
edits.after: Maiden plus a bruiser item out-damages your sustain; fight only in the window after Mourning Mist misses.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Yorick carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: A full ghoul pack and the Maiden out-split you — carry threat 7/10, so group where a single cage matters far less.

edits.before: Traps you for the ghouls. Don’t get caged. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Dark Procession is 20s at rank 1, and the cage is destructible — hit it down.

edits.before: Q-bite Yorick as he steps up (hold Q to follow his dash), weave autos, and let the passive out-heal his return damage.
edits.after: Mourning Mist is 12s at rank 1 and cuts your armour — step up in the window after it lands, not while the mark is fresh.

edits.before: That is Yorick's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: The cage is real terrain — it blocks your Q lunge and your R leap both ways.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Mourning Mist marks you and every ghoul sprints at the mark.

notes: The cage was named in four fields and explained in none. It is destructible terrain, which matters twice over for Warwick: it walls off both his Q lunge and his R leap, and it can be attacked down rather than walked around. No mirror audit existed for this matchup.
